metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills for various tools and services

plugins.name: shortcut
plugins.description: Work with Shortcut stories, epics, objectives, iterations, docs, labels, and teams - view, search, create, and update

plugins.name: ponder
plugins.description: Build EVM blockchain data indexers using Ponder (ponder.sh) - index smart contract events into queryable databases with type-safe APIs

plugins.name: review-workflow
plugins.description: Iterative code-review loop — review the diff, fix critical/major/minor issues, commit each round, re-review until clean. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: job-apply
plugins.description: Tailor a CV and cover letter to a specific job posting and apply to it automatically in the browser, keeping a reusable profile so the same answers are never re-entered

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Sweep job boards in the browser and build a deduplicated pipeline of roles worth applying to, sharing a workspace with job-apply so a role applied to is never surfaced twice
